faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Deoghar Health Economist & Scientist-C posts is 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Health Economist & Scientist-C posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Health Economist & Scientist-C positions at AIIMS Deoghar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Health Economist post?
faq.answer: For the Health Economist position, a Master's degree in Health Economics, Economics, Public Health, or Community Medicine with specialization in Healthcare Costing and Economic Evaluation is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 40 years, with applicable age relaxations for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these contractual roles?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,000/- per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email to the designated address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Health Economist & Scientist-C posts?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an Interview. A written or skill test might be conducted if deemed necessary.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.

faq.question: Q10. What is the tentative date for the interview?
faq.answer: The tentative date for the Written Test/Skill Test/Interview is 19th September 2026.
